title: ClimatePlan v1
description: The body of a 200 answer of GET /climate/plan: the advisory plan of the climate optimizer (docs/climate-plan-contract.md, ADR-0008 proposed). Consumers must treat a plan past valid_until, a status other than planned, or a document that fails this schema as ABSENT. The optimizer never acts on it.

version.description: Contract version. A consumer must refuse any other value.

advisory.description: Always true in v1: the plan is a recommendation, never a command.

plan_id.description: Hash of the plan's content (everything but the mode fields and summary). The same decision always gives the same id: apply a plan once per plan_id.

valid_until.description: t0 + plan_ttl_minutes (90). At or after this instant the plan is absent.

t0.description: The decision boundary: the start of slot 0.

regime.description: Control regime the optimizer saw at the decision.

reason.description: Why there is no plan (skipped, error); null when planned.

solver_status.description: optimal, gap or time_limit for a plan.

comfort.description: Per room, the comfort levels the plan was computed with (the controller's helpers when present, else the optimizer's config). Rooms: bedroom, hall_kitchen, office_t. Empty when the decision failed before the levels were known.

away.description: Away mode at the decision (every room planned at its floor + 0.5 K); null when unknown.

weather.description: Outdoor temperature over the horizon: the issued forecast, or the last reading held.

slots.description: Columnar per-slot plan over the horizon; null unless status is planned. Slot i covers [start + i * step_minutes, start + (i + 1) * step_minutes). All arrays have length n.

heating.description: 1: space heating planned on (it permits heating; the heat pump still follows its thermostats); 0: planned off.

water_c.description: Absolute water target in degC, already clamped to 20..35, in heating slots; null where heating is 0.

dhw.description: 1: the plan assumed hot-water production in the slot (the controller owns it); heating is 0 there.

predicted_room_c.description: Per room, the model's air temperature at the END of each slot under this plan. Monitoring only.

requested_mode.description: What the owner asked for (HA select, else the config fallback).

effective_mode.description: What the optimizer does. Never live in this code version.

live_locked.description: True while live is requested and refused.

summary.description: Derived at the instant of the request, for dashboards. A consumer never needs it: the slots are the contract.

next_heating_start.description: Start of the next heating run after the current slot.

next_heating_stop.description: End of the current heating run, else of the next one.

instant.description: ISO 8601, always UTC with a +00:00 offset.
